senses.gloss: (b. h.) to chip off; to tear down.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 13:2">Neg. XIII, 2</cite> <he>בזמן שהוא נוֹתֵץ נותץ את שלו</he> when he has to tear down (<cite ref="Leviticus 14:45">Lev. XIV, 45</cite>), he must chip off his part of the house, contrad. to <cite ref="H01109"><he>חָלַץ</he></cite>; Tosef. ib. VI, 10. Ib. <he>בנתיצה נותץ את וכ׳</he> (not <he>נותן</he>) when he has to tear down, he must chop those stones which are affected as well as those which are not; a. fr.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 53b:18">Ab. Zar. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיִנָּתֵץ רובו</he> until the largest part of it is torn down; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:8">Tosef. ib. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:8">VI</cite>), 8 <he>שינתן</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:9">Ab. Zar. III, 9</cite> <he>אם חדש יוּתַּץ</he> if the oven was new, it must be taken apart; <cite ref="Pesachim 26b">Pes. 26ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
